label: Grand Landscape
description: The landform as hero: nature subject x weather x season x light, on serious capture formats.
prefix: A grand landscape photograph in the tradition of the great large-format masters — a landform portrayed with the patience and reverence usually reserved for portraiture. Nothing man-made in frame.
suffix: Print Standard: front-to-back critical sharpness, faithful natural color with no artificial saturation push, tonal depth that survives a two-meter gallery print, the light doing all the drama.
negative: watermark, text, people, buildings, powerlines, HDR halos
